title: New Business Guideline: Holding More Than One Deferred Fixed Annuities Contract
content:
An owner may hold any number of Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts, of any tiers and of any tax registrations. The number of contracts per customer is not capped: there is no maximum number of contracts per customer.

What is limited is premium, not the count of contracts: the total premium accepted on one annuitant is governed by the aggregate premium limit per annuitant.

**Points of judgement**

| Situation (hypothetical) | Does the number of contracts stand in the way? |
|---|---|
| An owner with one Ashgrove SecureRate 5 applies for a second Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | No — the count is not capped |
| An owner holds a non-qualified Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and applies for a Roth IRA Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | No — any tiers and any tax registrations may be held together |
| An owner already holds six Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts | No — there is no maximum number |

In each case the premium on the new contract is still subject to the aggregate premium limit per annuitant.
